packageRules.description: npm packages can be unpublished within 72 hours and hijacked releases surface in the first days, so the dashboard offers the newest version that is at least 3 days old. Vulnerability fix PRs ignore this by default.
The lint plugin is young; each release may add findings, so bump it weekly and let the CI lint job show the effect.
Actions are pinned to commit SHAs, which nobody can read well enough to approve from the dashboard.
